'''KT-55''' was a [[Gender/Legends|feminine]] [[Assassin droid/Legends|assassin droid]] active during the [[Galactic War]]. Along with its twin [[PR-98]], KT-55 was part of the [[Crimson Fang]] gang, which following the death of Empress [[Vaylin]] and formation of the [[Eternal Alliance]] in [[3630 BBY]] took over [[Port Nowhere]] by force, planning to use the mobile space station as their base of operations. The Alliance send a strike team on a mission to liberate Port Nowhere, who systematically rid the station of Outer Rim's most notorious villains, eventually confronting KT-55 and PR-98 and destroying them.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
KT-55 appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne]]'' as a boss during the "Crimson Fang" Uprising.
